what: Phone clips, when someone filmed them
install: Place a filmed clip in the local inbox.
Use the ffmpeg binary already on this machine.

what: Motion page, CSS and inline SVG
install: Open /video in a browser on this machine. Nothing is installed and no video file is made.

what: Caption and script draft on a free-tier model
install: A person pastes the script text into a model they already use and keeps only the lines they can check.
A person runs the verify command from /start on each TrustShell line and uses what it printed. If it was not run, the line stays NOT_CHECKED.

what: Screen recording of the motion page
install: A person records /video#record with the screen recorder already on this machine. The recording stays on that machine.
A person signs in to their own Metricool account and schedules the clip after reading it. The monthly cap is on Metricool's help page.
cost: free tier, cap on Metricool's help page
